comments.body:
Looks as if this (but not the corresponding recipe book, alas) is being released in the Super Warships Premium Bottle (8/5). Stats are as listed above, it's pretty obviously Female-Only, and it should be color-custom. Hope the rest of the recipe book gear is released one day.
